item.title: Displaced by development, Cape Fear animals get a second chance at local rescue
item.description: The Cape Fear region is home to some of the fastest-growing counties in North Carolina. But as development expands, natural habitats are disappearing.

item.title: Preparations underway in the Cape Fear for possible winter weather impact
item.description: Multiple agencies across North Carolina are preparing ahead of a winter storm expected to impact our state this weekend.

item.title: Whiteville native Mackenzie Gore traded in blockbuster deal to the Texas Rangers
item.description: 2025 All-Star selection and Whiteville native Mackenzie Gore has been traded in a blockbuster deal from the Washington Nationals to the Texas Rangers.

item.title: Kurt Busch says he ‘wouldn’t change a thing’ as he prepares to enter NASCAR’s Hall of Fame
item.description: Success and fame came quickly for Kurt Busch. In hindsight, maybe a little too fast for the driver known as “The Outlaw.”

item.title: Sundance kicks off its last year in Utah with powerful premieres and tributes to Robert Redford
item.description: Robert Redford liked to say that everybody has a story. He’s not the only person who said it, but he is one of the few who did something to celebrate it, his daughter, Amy Redford, said Wednesday evening ahead of the Sundance Film Festival's opening day.

item.title: TikTok finalizes deal to form new American entity
item.description: TikTok has finalized a deal to create a new American entity, avoiding the looming threat of a ban in the United States that has been in discussion for years.

item.description: Someone fired a gun into a home on Old Stake Road south of Chadbourn around 2 am Thursday.

item.title: How to prepare your home and garden plants ahead of winter storms
item.description: As winter weather heads our way, it's important to take steps now to ensure your home is adequately prepared to handle any storm impacts we could see here in the Cape Fear.
